latest_release.name: 3.5.0 New Conversions are Live! and Desktop reload fix and more
latest_release.body:
Stirling Office Convert has now replaced Libreoffice in our docker containers! 
Along with speed increases and better quality conversions it also means our docker going forward in 3.5.1 will be half the size!  Thank you to everyone who sent us example files, and please keep reporting any conversions that don't look right! We are hoping to get this perfect!

We have also made a big fix for desktop users whose documents were reloading a few seconds after upload, Thank you to everyone who reported this and great to see people using the new feedback button! (In bottom right) 

With the Office Convert change (outside of the tools getting the toggle removed)
- Compress now uses Office Convert
- HTML to PDF supports zoom again
- New admin setting to cap how many Office conversions run at once and queue
- Damaged Office, ebook and HTML files now give a clear "could not be read" message instead of an error

Other changes are:
- Faster desktop PDF operations, with the PDF engine now pre-installed in the app
- Performance improvements across the viewer, file list etc
- JPDFium and other dependency updates causing various bug fixes and improvements 

We also fixed some bugs including:
- Desktop documents reloading themselves and losing progress shortly after being opened
- Filled form fields showing their value twice in the viewer
- Form values being invisible in dark mode
- Thumbnail sidebar getting stuck on "Loading..." after applying changes

Note (breaking changes):
- PDF to .doc (Word 97-2003) output has been removed. Use docx or odt instead; API calls, pipelines and automations asking for `doc` will now return an error
- .wpd, .wps, .lwp, .abw, .hwp and .xps files are no longer accepted for conversion
- `groupsToRemove` entries for removed tools (LibreOffice, Calibre, Weasyprint, OpenCV, etc.) no longer disable anything. 

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes
* fix(frontend): silence dev proxy ECONNREFUSED spam by @balazs-szucs in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8853
* fix(ui): align add-password advanced dropdown to be more consistent with the rest of the UI by @balazs-szucs in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8760
### Enhancements
* Support accessibility tagging of formulas in Text Editor by @EthanHealy01 in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8945
* Send self-hosted Enterprise buyers to the hosted Enterprise page by @reecebrowne in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8940
* Ask signed-out desktop users to sign in for tools that need an account by @Frooodle in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8952
* perf(analytics): start the PostHog client lazily and cut its queue thread wakeups by @balazs-szucs in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8562
* perf(viewer): decouple toolbar notifier subscriptions from state variables by @balazs-szucs in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8438
* perf(files): consolidate filtering and reduce temporary allocations by @balazs-szucs in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8557
* perf(policies): fetch the policy list once per session state by @balazs-szucs in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8357
* refactor(settings): improve accessibility and styling for settings navigation by @balazs-szucs in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8701
* Update and improve zh-TW Traditional Chinese translations by @PeterDaveHello in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8657
* Never reload an open document from disk; only track its original going missing by @Frooodle in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8980
* Fix viewer drawing filled form values twice by @Frooodle in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/9007
* Ship JPDFium natives pre-installed in the desktop bundle by @Frooodle in

detail.readme:
Stirling PDF - The Open-Source PDF Platform

Stirling PDF is a powerful, open-source PDF editing platform. Run it as a personal desktop app, in the browser, or deploy it on your own servers with a private API. Edit, sign, redact, convert, and automate PDFs without sending documents to external services.

![Stirling PDF - Dashboard](docs/images/home-light.png) ## Key Capabilities - **Everywhere you work** - Desktop client, browser UI, and self-hosted server with a private API. - **50+ PDF tools** - Edit, merge, split, sign, redact, convert, OCR, compress, and more. - **Automation & workflows** - No-code pipelines direct in UI with APIs to process millions of PDFs. - **Enterprise‑grade** - SSO, auditing, and flexible on‑prem deployments. - **Developer platform** - REST APIs available for nearly all tools to integrate into your existing systems. - **Global UI** - Interface available in 40+ languages. For a full feature list, see the docs: **https://docs.stirlingpdf.com** ## Quick Start ```bash docker run -p 8080:8080 docker.stirlingpdf.com/stirlingtools/stirling-pdf ``` Then open: http://localhost:8080 For full installation options (including desktop and Kubernetes), see our [Documentation Guide](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com/#documentation-guide). ## Resources - [**Documentation**](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com) - [**Homepage**](https://stirling.com) - [**API Docs**](https://registry.scalar.com/@stirlingpdf/apis/stirling-pdf-processing-api/) - [**Server Plan & Enterprise**](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com/Paid-Offerings) ## Support - **Community**: [Discord](https://discord.gg/HYmhKj45pU) - **Bug Reports**: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/issues) ## Contributing We welcome contributions! Please see [CONTRIBUTING.md](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidelines. This project uses [Task](https://taskfile.dev/) as a unified command runner for all build, dev, and test commands. Run `task dev` to get started running the editor, run `task` to see the most common commands, or see the [Developer Guide](docs/developer/DeveloperGuide.md) for full details. For adding translations, see the [Translation Guide](docs/developer/HowToAddNewLanguage.md). ## License Stirling PDF is open-core. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for details.
